test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: To be successful in a competition, Marlin needs an average of 100 scores in the 4 exams. The scores of the previous three exams are 136, 106, and 76, respectively. To succeed in the competition, how much will he have to score in the fourth test?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Target Average = 100

Deviations of the previous 3 exams from 100 = +36, +6, and −24

Net deviation = 36 + 6 − 24 = +18

To balance the average to 100, the 4th exam must have an opposite deviation of −18.

Score in the 4th exam = 100 − 18 = 82

**∴ The correct answer is 82 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Target average for 4 exams = 100

Scores in the first three exams = 136, 106, 76

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the score required in the 4th exam be x.

⇒ Total sum needed for 4 exams = Target Average × 4

⇒ 136 + 106 + 76 + x = 100 × 4

⇒ 318 + x = 400

⇒ x = 400 − 318

⇒ x = 82

**∴ The correct answer is 82 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

The arithmetic mean or average of 'n' values is equal to the total sum of all values divided by 'n'.

Net Deviation Method

The total algebraic sum of deviations of all values from their true arithmetic mean is always equal to zero.

Finding a Missing Value

Missing Value = (Target Average × Total number of items) − (Sum of all known items).
